q: 奶奶没学过用手机，所以不___用。
en: Grandma has never learned to use a phone, so she can't use one.

q: 冬天我们去滑冰，可是我没学过，不___滑。
en: We go skating in winter, but I have never learned, so I can't skate.

q: 弟弟从小在海边长大，很小就___游泳。
en: My younger brother grew up by the sea and could swim from a very young age.

q: 她是医生，学了八年，___做手术。
en: She is a doctor who trained for eight years, so she knows how to operate.

q: 她学过按摩，所以___按肩膀，按得很舒服。
en: She has studied massage, so she knows how to massage shoulders, and it feels very comfortable.

q: 明天___下雪，你多穿一件衣服。
en: It will snow tomorrow, so put on an extra layer.

q: 天气预报说，周末___下大雨。
en: The forecast says it will pour this weekend.

q: 夏天太热了，不戴帽子，你___头疼。
en: It is so hot in summer; without a hat you will get a headache.

q: 别怕，打针一点儿也不___疼。
en: Don't be scared; the injection won't hurt at all.

q: 如果你每天睡得太少，身体就___生病。
en: If you sleep too little every day, you will get sick.

q: 春天一到，天气就___慢慢变暖。
en: Once spring arrives, the weather will gradually warm up.

q: 医生说，只要你按时吃药，过几天感冒就___好。
en: The doctor says that if you take your medicine on time, the cold will clear up in a few days.

q: 你放心，这个药吃了不___想睡觉。
en: Don't worry; this medicine won't make you sleepy.

q: 你放心，我不___忘记吃药的。
en: Don't worry, I won't forget to take my medicine.

q: 别担心，明天天气一定___好的。
en: Don't worry, the weather will definitely be fine tomorrow.

q: 别担心，我一定会按时回家___。
en: Don't worry, I will definitely be home on time.

q: 你放心，我绝对不___把你的病告诉别人的。
en: Don't worry, I will absolutely not tell anyone about your illness.

q: 医生说你不用担心，这个手术不___有危险的。
en: The doctor says not to worry; this operation will not be dangerous.

q: 别难过，雨停以后，太阳一定___出来的。
en: Don't be sad; after the rain stops, the sun will definitely come out.

q: 别急，你的感冒过几天就___好___。
en: Don't worry, your cold will be better in a few days.

q: 只要你多休息，身体一定会好起来___。
en: As long as you rest more, you will certainly get better.

q: 我会游泳，但是今天发烧了，不___下水。
en: I can swim, but I have a fever today, so I can't get in the water.

q: 我会开车，可是我吃了感冒药，现在不___开车。
en: I can drive, but I have taken cold medicine, so I can't drive right now.

q: 他会弹钢琴，可是手受伤了，这个月不___弹。
en: He can play the piano, but his hand is injured, so he can't play this month.

q: 奶奶的腿好了，现在___自己下楼了。
en: Grandma's leg has healed, and now she can go downstairs by herself again.

q: 手机没电了，我现在不___给你拍照。
en: My phone is out of battery, so I can't take your photo now.

q: 雨停了，路也干了，我们现在___出发了。
en: The rain has stopped and the road is dry, so we can set off now.

q: 你的肚子还在疼，现在不___喝冰水。
en: Your stomach still hurts, so you can't drink ice water now.

q: 台风来了，所有的航班都取消了，今天谁也不___坐飞机去上海。
en: A typhoon has arrived and every flight is cancelled, so nobody can fly to Shanghai today.

q: 我的手好了，现在___拿东西了。
en: My hand has healed, so I can carry things again now.

q: 河里的冰太薄了，现在不___在上面走。
en: The ice on the river is too thin; you can't walk on it now.

q: 牙不疼了，现在什么都___吃了。
en: My tooth no longer hurts; now I can eat anything.

q: 他一口气___吃五个包子，真厉害。
en: He can eat five steamed buns in one go; that is impressive.

q: 我现在一次___游五十米。
en: I can swim fifty metres at a time now.

q: 她跑得很快，一分钟___跑三百米。
en: She runs fast; she can run three hundred metres in a minute.

q: 他的力气很大，一只手就___拿二十公斤的米。
en: He is very strong; he can lift twenty kilos of rice with one hand.

q: 这辆自行车很快，一个小时___骑二十公里。
en: This bike is fast; you can ride twenty kilometres in an hour.

q: 爸爸的身体很好，现在一口气___爬二十层楼。
en: Dad is in good health; he can now climb twenty floors in one go.

q: 腿很疼，我现在连五分钟都不___站。
en: My leg hurts so much that I can't even stand for five minutes now.

q: 冬天白天很短，下午五点天就黑了，我们最多只___玩两个小时。
en: Winter days are short and it is dark by five, so we can play for two hours at most.

q: 这个杯子很小，只___装一杯水。
en: This cup is small; it can only hold one cup of water.

q: 我头疼得厉害，晚上每次只___睡两个小时。
en: My headache is terrible; I can only sleep two hours at a time at night.

q: 这儿___吃东西吗？
en: Is it all right to eat here?

q: 医生，我今天___洗澡吗？
en: Doctor, may I take a bath today?

q: 太冷了，你___穿我的外套。
en: It's too cold; you can wear my coat.

q: 雨下得太大了，你们___在我家住一晚。
en: It is raining too hard; you can stay the night at my place.

q: 考试的时候，___带笔，但是不能带手机。
en: During the exam you may bring a pen, but not a phone.

q: 要是你觉得身体不舒服，___先回家休息，我替你上课。
en: If you feel unwell, you can go home and rest first; I'll cover your class.

q: 我明天要去看病，不___来上课了。
en: I'm going to the doctor tomorrow, so I can't come to class.

q: 雪太大了，飞机今天不___起飞。
en: The snow is too heavy, so planes can't take off today.

q: 图书馆里不___大声说话，别人在看书。
en: You can't talk loudly in the library; others are reading.

q: 你放心，他不___生气，他很爱笑。
en: Don't worry, he won't be angry; he laughs easily.

q: 天这么蓝，今天不___下雨。
en: The sky is so blue; it won't rain today.

q: 小王：我可以坐这儿吗？小李：不___，这儿有人了。
en: Xiao Wang: May I sit here? Xiao Li: No, someone is already sitting here.

q: 他刚到中国，还不___用筷子，吃饭很慢。
en: He has just arrived in China and can't use chopsticks yet, so he eats slowly.

q: 放心，这点雪不___影响明天的比赛。
en: Don't worry, this little snow won't affect tomorrow's game.

q: 她唱歌很好听，只是今天感冒了，不___唱。
en: She sings beautifully; she just has a cold today and can't sing.

q: 我妈妈很___做饭，做的菜都很好吃。
en: My mum is really good at cooking; everything she makes tastes good.

q: 我哥哥很___吃，一顿吃四碗饭。
en: My older brother can really eat; he has four bowls of rice at a meal.

q: 护士很___照顾病人，病人都喜欢她。
en: The nurse is very good at looking after patients; they all like her.

q: 这个孩子真___睡，一天睡十六个小时。
en: This kid can really sleep: sixteen hours a day.

q: 小李真___说，开会时他一个人说了一个小时，别人都没机会说话。
en: Xiao Li can really talk; at the meeting he talked alone for an hour and nobody else got a word in.

q: 我女儿特别___画画，老师说她画得很好。
en: My daughter is especially good at drawing; the teacher says she draws very well.

q: 弟弟特别___吃辣，一大碗辣面也吃得完。
en: My younger brother can really handle spicy food; he can finish a big bowl of spicy noodles.

q: 她很___安慰人，我难过的时候，她总是知道说什么。
en: She is very good at comforting people; when I'm sad, she always knows what to say.
